works.title: The Apostolic Fathers
works.subtitle: Greek Texts and English Translations, 3rd ed.
works.author: Michael W. Holmes
works.blurb: The standard scholarly diglot of the earliest sub-apostolic writings, containing Polycarp's Letter to the Philippians and the Martyrdom of Polycarp — the bishop of Smyrna who learned from the Apostle John and gave the Church its archetypal martyr's confession.
